questions.prompt: Greet a familiar partner. Swap roles and identify whom the pronouns refer to in each turn.
questions.context:
You and a familiar partner meet. First you speak to the partner; then the partner speaks to you. Identify the current speaker and listener each time. No third person is present.
Familiar meanings available: hello; hi; I; me; you.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: I used the pronoun for the current speaker or listener.
I considered the relationship instead of treating a greeting as suitable everywhere.

coverage.scope: Notice that greetings and speaker reference depend on the relationship and situation.
